image_evaluations.ground_truth_diagnosis: Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) larval infestation inside green cotton boll
image_evaluations.raw_response:
ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) సిఫార్సు చేసిన మార్గదర్శకాల ప్రకారం (ICAR-CICR Best Management Practices for Cotton in India 2025, పేజీ 6):
Cotton Pink Bollworm management and prevention: Install 8 pheromone traps per acre during flowering and boll formation stage. Economic Threshold Level (ETL) is 8 moths per trap per day for 3 consecutive days. For control, spray Neem oil 10,000 PPM at 400-500 ml per acre in 200 liters of water or Chlorantraniliprole 18.

image_evaluations.ground_truth_diagnosis: Rice Blast (Pyricularia oryzae) spindle-shaped necrotic foliar lesions with greyish center
image_evaluations.raw_response:
ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR) సిఫార్సు చేసిన మార్గదర్శకాల ప్రకారం (ICAR-IIRR Rice Crop Production & Protection Guidelines 2025, పేజీ 18):
Paddy rice leaves turning yellow due to zinc deficiency or iron chlorosis: Yellowing appears on younger leaves and spreads down the blades. Spray Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4) at 2 grams per liter of water (400-500 grams per acre in 200 liters of water) twice at 10-day intervals.

image_evaluations.ground_truth_diagnosis: Chilli Anthracnose / Fruit Rot (Colletotrichum capsici) circular sunken necrotic spots on ripe chilli fruit
image_evaluations.raw_response:
Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU) సిఫార్సు చేసిన మార్గదర్శకాల ప్రకారం (PJTSAU Chilli Production & IPM Advisory Bulletin 2025, పేజీ 11):
Chilli thrips, yellow mites, and leaf curl management: Upward curling is caused by thrips, while downward curling indicates yellow mites. Spray Neem oil 10,000 PPM at 2-3 ml per liter of water, or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG at 80-100 grams per acre in 200 liters of water. Install 15-20 blue and yellow sticky traps per acre.
